recommended_ingestion_source: generic_csv (OrderDataSource.generic_csv) -- confirmed via direct comparison that none of Shopify's/WooCommerce's literal column headers are present in this file; GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP's headers match this file's own columns almost verbatim.
summary: Cleanest Ecommerce dataset found in the repository: 982 rows, 0 duplicate order_ids, 0 nulls in any of the 20 columns except the two return-detail columns (which are legitimately null for the 920 non-returned orders), gross_revenue exactly equals unit_price*quantity for all 982 rows, and every canonical field GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP expects has a literal, exact-match column in this file.

field_mapping.evidence: GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['external_order_id']='order_id', exact literal match, ecommerce_ingestion.py:92
GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['order_date']='order_date', exact literal match; parsed via pd.to_datetime, 0 unparseable rows observed

GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP has no key mapping any field to a 'customer_id' source column; the canonical Order.customer_id is instead derived separately from customer_email via resolve_customer_id() (uuid5 hash), so this file's own customer_id column is never read by the ingestion code at all.

GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['customer_email']='customer_email'; resolve_customer_id() (ecommerce_ingestion.py:245-248) hashes the lowercased email into a deterministic uuid5 as Order.customer_id -- the email string itself is not stored anywhere.
GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['channel']='channel', exact literal match. All 982 rows populated (0 nulls).
GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['sku']='sku', exact literal match. All 982 rows populated (0 nulls) -- every order will produce an OrderItem row.
No canonical field for a human-readable product name exists anywhere in OrderItem or Order; GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP has no key for it.
GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['quantity']='quantity', exact literal match, cast to int.
GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['unit_price']='unit_price', exact literal match.
GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['gross_revenue']='gross_revenue', exact literal match. Confirmed equals unit_price*quantity for all 982 rows (0 mismatches, independently recomputed).
GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['unit_cogs']='cogs', exact literal match, 0 nulls. Order.cogs is then DERIVED as unit_cogs*quantity (ecommerce_ingestion.py:324), not read directly from any single source column.

No canonical field named/aliased 'returns_amount' exists in GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP or the Order/OrderItem/Return models -- this column is never read. Distinct from 'refund_amount' (which IS mapped) and from the Return model's own 'return_cost'/'refund_amount' fields (which are populated by a wholly separate, not-yet-exercised Return-table write path not present in ecommerce_ingestion.py at all).
GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['refund_amount']='refund_amount', exact literal match. Also feeds _resolve_generic_status() to derive OrderStatus.refunded vs fulfilled.

GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['shipping_cost']='shipping_cost', exact literal match. Fully prorated onto the single line item as unit_shipping_cost (ecommerce_ingestion.py:315, documented as a consequence of the one-item-per-order simplification).
GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['processing_fees']='processing_fee', exact literal match. This field is GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP-only -- would resolve to None under shopify_csv/woocommerce_csv sources.
GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['allocated_ad_spend']='ad_spend_allocated', exact literal match. GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP-only field, same as processing_fee.
GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['discount_amount']='discount_amount', exact literal match.

Not read by ecommerce_ingestion.py at all. Conceptually maps to the separate Return model's 'carrier_id' field, but no ingestion code path writes Return rows from this CSV -- confirmed via reading ecommerce_ingestion.py in full (no Return import, no Return(...) construction anywhere in the file).
Same as return_carrier -- conceptually maps to Return.return_reason_code but no write path exists in ecommerce_ingestion.py.

GENERIC_COLUMN_MAP['original_currency']='currency', exact literal match. All 982 rows populated with 'NGN' (single distinct value, 0 nulls) -- this file does not exercise real multi-currency handling.

data_quality.malformed_prices: None found -- 0 negative unit_price, 0 zero unit_price, 0 negative gross_revenue, 0 negative cogs.
data_quality.malformed_timestamps: None found -- 0 unparseable order_date values (all 982 parse cleanly). Date range: 2025-07-01 to 2026-05-26.
data_quality.malformed_currencies: None found -- single distinct currency value ('NGN') across all 982 rows, no mixed/unsupported currency codes.
data_quality.missing_customer_ids: customer_id column itself has 0 nulls, but is never read by ingestion (see field_mapping) -- customer_email (which IS used) also has 0 nulls, so every order will resolve a non-null Order.customer_id via the email hash.
data_quality.encoding_problems: None observed during pandas read (utf-8 default read succeeded without errors).
data_quality.orphan_records: N/A -- single flat file, no parent/child relationship to check.
data_quality.unsupported_currencies: None -- only 'NGN' present, which the ingestion code accepts as-is (also happens to be the same value ecommerce_ingestion.py falls back to by default when a currency column is absent elsewhere).
data_quality.inconsistent_channel_names: Not fully enumerated in this pass (channel is present and non-null in all rows; distinct-value enumeration not performed since channel has no validation/normalization logic in the ingestion code to check against).
data_quality.invalid_return_data: return_carrier/return_reason are null for the 920 rows with returns_amount=0 and populated for the 62 rows with a non-zero returns_amount -- internally consistent, but see field_mapping: neither return_carrier nor return_reason nor returns_amount is actually read by the ingestion code, so this internal consistency has no bearing on what gets written to the database.

verdict: PASS. This is the highest-fidelity Ecommerce dataset in the repository for exercising the full canonical schema (SKU, COGS, currency, customer identity, channel, discount/refund/shipping/processing-fee/ad-spend all present and clean). Recommended as the primary Ecommerce ingestion test case for Prompt 2, with source=generic_csv.
